SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT db.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY db.source_document_id ORDER BY
CASE WHEN LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', file_doc.title, db.chapter, db.section, db.source_path, db.block_role, db.raw_text, db.normalized_text)) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{term}), '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, db.block_order ASC, db.id ASC ) AS file_rank FROM document_block db JOIN source_document file_doc ON file_doc.id = db.source_document_id WHERE file_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_doc.source_type = 'feishu' AND file_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' AND file_doc.parse_status IN ('parsed', 'completed') AND file_doc.embedding_status IN ('ready', 'completed') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE' AND db.status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_document root_doc WHERE root_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root_doc.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.rootDocumentId')) AS UNSIGNED) AND root_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' )
AND (file_doc.created_by = #{viewerSubjectId} OR file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TEACHER_SHARED', 'TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED'))
AND file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED')
AND 1 = 0
AND (
LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', file_doc.title, db.chapter, db.section, db.source_path, db.block_role, db.raw_text, db.normalized_text)) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{term}), '%')
) ) ranked WHERE ranked.file_rank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.block_order ASC, ranked.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT db.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY db.source_document_id ORDER BY db.block_order ASC, db.id ASC ) AS file_rank FROM document_block db JOIN source_document file_doc ON file_doc.id = db.source_document_id WHERE file_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_doc.source_type = 'feishu' AND file_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' AND file_doc.parse_status IN ('parsed', 'completed') AND file_doc.embedding_status IN ('ready', 'completed') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.documentKind')) = 'FILE' AND db.status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_document root_doc WHERE root_doc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root_doc.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(file_doc.metadata_json, '$.rootDocumentId')) AS UNSIGNED) AND root_doc.sync_status <> 'archived' )
AND (file_doc.created_by = #{viewerSubjectId} OR file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TEACHER_SHARED', 'TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED'))
AND file_doc.permission_scope IN ('TENANT_PUBLIC', 'PUBLIC_TEXTBOOK', 'MATH_VIP', 'CLASS_AUTHORIZED')
AND 1 = 0
AND (
JSON_SEARCH(COALESCE(db.graph_tag_names_json, JSON_ARRAY()), 'one', #{tagName}) IS NOT NULL
) ) ranked WHERE ranked.file_rank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.block_order ASC, ranked.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
